KXHIGHTSATX.title: San Antonio Daily Maximum Temperature
KXHIGHTSATX.sample_rules: If the maximum temperature recorded at San Antonio (CLISAT) for Nov 21, 2026, is greater than 79° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXHIGHTNOLA.title: New Orleans Max temp Daily
KXHIGHTNOLA.sample_rules: If the maximum temperature recorded at New Orleans (CLIMSY) for Nov 21, 2026, is greater than 78° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.
